module purpose: neorv32_cpu is the top-level CPU wrapper that connects the frontend, control, counters, register file, ALU, LSU, PMP, and optional ICC sub-blocks. In this file it routes the external interrupt/debug, bus, and ICC interfaces, and locally forms the machine-interrupt bundle, the aggregated xCSR read-data value, and the register-file writeback value.

use-case flows.value: external debug, fast, and machine interrupt indications delivered to the control sub-block
aggregated xCSR read-data contribution formed from ALU, counters, PMP, and ICC sources and sent to the control sub-block
register-file writeback value formed from ALU, LSU, CSR, and pc_ret sources and driven into the register-file sub-block
PMP fault indication sent to control and LSU, or forced to zero when PMP support is not built

conceptual assets.concept: Debug interrupt request delivered to the control sub-block
conceptual assets.reasoning: The start flow directly maps the external input `dbi_i` into the control sub-block as `irq_dbg_i` (line 266, CONNECTS at occurrence 2 of `dbi_i`). Integrity is Established because the consuming control logic must receive exactly the external debug-request value that this entity presents. Availability is also Established because the connection is unconditional whenever the input is driven.

conceptual assets.concept: Fast interrupt request vector delivered to the control sub-block
conceptual assets.reasoning: The start flow directly maps the external vector `firq_i` into the control sub-block as `irq_fast_i` (line 268, CONNECTS at occurrence 2 of `firq_i`). Integrity is Established because the consuming control logic must receive exactly the fast-interrupt vector this entity is given. Availability is also Established because the vector is passed through whenever the input is driven.

conceptual assets.concept: Machine interrupt bundle formed from the three machine interrupt inputs
conceptual assets.reasoning: This entity locally computes `irq_machine <= mti_i & mei_i & msi_i;` (line 276; `irq_machine` has DERIVES_FROM there) and delivers that bundle to the control sub-block as `irq_machine_i` (line 267). Integrity is Established because the consumer depends on the exact three-input bundle this entity defines. Availability is also Established because the bundle is produced combinationally from the current inputs.

conceptual assets.concept: Aggregated xCSR read-data value delivered to the control sub-block
conceptual assets.reasoning: The read-out flow combines the optional source vectors with `xcsr_res <= xcsr_cnt or xcsr_alu or xcsr_pmp or xcsr_icc;` (line 279) and passes the result into control as `xcsr_rdata_i` (line 264). The build-time disabled branches force zero contributions at lines 305 (`xcsr_cnt`), 426 (`xcsr_pmp`), and 454 (`xcsr_icc`). Integrity is Established because the control sub-block must receive exactly the aggregate value this entity defines under the selected build configuration. Availability is also Established because the absent contributors are explicitly driven to zero rather than left undefined.

conceptual assets.concept: Register-file writeback value delivered to the register-file sub-block
conceptual assets.reasoning: The operate flow locally computes `rf_wdata <= alu_res or lsu_rdata or csr_rdata or ctrl.pc_ret;` (line 330) and drives that value into the register-file sub-block on `rd_i` (line 323). Integrity is Established because the register-file consumer must receive exactly the writeback value defined by this combination, and corruption would change subsequent CPU operation through later register reads. Availability is also Established because this combinational value is continuously presented from its sources.

conceptual assets.concept: PMP fault indication delivered to control and LSU
conceptual assets.reasoning: When PMP support is built, the module receives `fault_o` from the PMP sub-block onto `pmp_fault` (line 420, CONNECTS mode out) and forwards it to control and LSU as `pmp_fault_i` (lines 257 and 392). When PMP support is not built, the disabled branch forces `pmp_fault <= '0'` (line 427). Integrity is Established because both consumers depend on the exact fault indication this entity provides under the selected configuration. Availability is also Established because the signal is explicitly produced in both branches: by the PMP block when enabled, and by a constant no-fault value when disabled.
